title: Where Zero Trust Branch operations are documented: forwarding, Routed Tunnels, segmentation, integrations, logging, monitoring, the Debug Console, troubleshooting and upgrades

prose.text: Internet & SaaS gateways, private application connectivity and site DNS policies are in [[zero-trust-branch.operations.sd-wan]], and site-to-site hubs and spokes are in [[zero-trust-branch.operations.routed-tunnels]].
Airgap, Airgap-Lite, assets, tags and the Ransomware Kill Switch are in [[zero-trust-branch.operations.segmentation]], and Airgap+ address layout is in [[zero-trust-branch.operations.micro-subnets]].

API keys, SIEM, CrowdStrike, Armis and SentinelOne are in [[zero-trust-branch.operations.integrations]], log types and retention are in [[zero-trust-branch.operations.logging]], and dashboards, alarms, SNMP and interface health are in [[zero-trust-branch.operations.monitoring]].

The Debug Console is in [[zero-trust-branch.operations.debug-console]], documented symptoms and checks are in [[zero-trust-branch.operations.troubleshooting]], and software upgrades are in [[zero-trust-branch.operations.upgrades]].
What the product is is in [[zero-trust-branch.overview]], and how an appliance is deployed is in [[zero-trust-branch.deployment]].
